capabilities: Capture a browser tab as a vector PDF with selectable, searchable text
Create a Markdown note containing the page's text with the PDF embedded under its properties
Connect to the Page Scanner browser extension through a local helper process
Configure the target folder, page size, theme, page width and clutter hiding
disambiguation: Not a scanner for paper documents or images; it captures open browser tabs into the vault.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Setup requires installing the browser extension, an npm CLI, and Node.js 22+; the plugin never downloads or installs code itself and all traffic stays on 127.0.0.1 with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture a whole browser tab as a searchable PDF and a Markdown note of its text in one step.

relations.evidence: It works through Page Scanner, a Chrome and Edge extension that captures whole pages
The plugin runs Page Scanner's command-line tool, the @page-scanner/cli package

requires.name: Page Scanner browser extension (Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons)
@page-scanner/cli installed with npm on Node.js 22 or newer

summary: Web page clipper that saves a browser tab into the vault as a vector PDF and a Markdown note, via the Page Scanner browser extension.
